intent.title: Protect the hospital slice (URLLC) and its portal
intent.description: A private 5G slice carries a hospital's clinical applications. Detect attacks that reach it through massive-IoT devices, subscriber-profile tampering, user-plane spoofing or volumetric floods; tell them apart from an authorised billing job; attach the critical-infrastructure and personal-data duties that a hospital setting raises.

reference_points.4: ML underlay network (live simulation) ↔ ML pipeline: collector reads diagnostics; SINKs act
reference_points.1,2: simulated ML underlay networks ↔ ML pipeline in the sandbox subsystem
reference_points.3: ML sandbox subsystem ↔ ML pipeline subsystem: trained model handed over at deployment
reference_points.5: management subsystem (MLFO) ↔ ML pipeline subsystem: instantiation, model updates
reference_points.6: management subsystem (MLFO) ↔ ML sandbox subsystem: training, evaluation, selection
reference_points.7: MLFO ↔ other management functions: the incident-response engine (ir/engine.py) and its human gates

instantiation.chain: SRC → C → PP → M → P → D → SINK

selections.rule: highest macro_f1 among candidates with macro_f1 ≥ 0.85 and p95 inference ≤ 80.0 ms

card.description: Baseline: max per-feature z-score against normal operation with a trained threshold; nearest class centroid names the incident
IsolationForest on normal operation (unknown anomalies) + RandomForest classifier (known incident classes)
